evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The current recover-kill proof still accepts any nonzero exit code. A normal nonzero recover failure can leave the pending drained record unchanged, so the subsequent record checks pass without proving the drain hook actually interrupted the process. The check should distinguish the SIGKILL interruption status (rc -9) from ordinary failure, and the corresponding runner predicate has the same gap.
